notes: A proper look at the window this time. Every row now shows WHAT IT DOES at a glance: each Mode has its own colour, its own drawn shape and its word, so a Repeat row and a Hold row no longer look identical. Every row also has a bar down its left edge, solid when the row is on and a faint line when it is off, so you can see what is switched on without reading a single tick box. A new What will run panel at the bottom right tells you how many rows are on and what they are, and doubles as the key to the colours. The window also opened with scrollbars it never needed, on any screen size, and now sizes itself to its own contents. Bigger title, the version on screen, and the footer cut from four lines of grey text to two.
